// Assumes 2 heuristics (0 and 1)\n\n    // Step 2: Update the exponential moving average Score 'S' for the active mode\n    // S_new = 0.8 * S_old + 0.2 * P\n    const double s_old = solver-\u003emab_reward[active];\n    const double s_new = 0.8 * s_old + 0.2 * p_metric;\n    \n    // Update the reward state\n    solver-\u003emab_reward[active] = s_new;\n\n    // Step 3: Calculate the discrete derivative 'Delta' of the score\n    // Delta = S_new - S_old\n    const double delta = s_new - s_old;\n\n    // Step 4: Execute Mode Selection using Trend-Contextualized logic\n    bool switch_heuristic = false;\n    const double s_inactive = solver-\u003emab_reward[inactive];\n\n    if (delta \u003e 0) {\n        // Improving: Deterministic keep of current mode.\n        switch_heuristic = false;\n    } else {\n        // Degrading (Delta \u003c 0)\n        double prob = 0.0;\n        \n        if (s_new \u003e s_inactive) {\n            // Degrading but still superior: Treat as noise.\n            // Switch with very low probability (0.05) to prevent thrashing.\n            prob = 0.05;\n        } else {\n            // Degrading and inferior: Switch with aggressive probability.\n            // prob = min(1.0, abs(Delta) * 10.0 + 0.2)\n            const double abs_delta = -delta; // delta is negative here\n            prob = abs_delta * 10.0 + 0.2;\n            if (prob \u003e 1.0) prob = 1.0;\n        }\n\n        // Random sampling to determine switch\n        const double rand_val = kissat_pick_double(&solver-\u003erandom);\n        if (rand_val \u003c prob) {\n            switch_heuristic = true;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Apply the heuristic switch if decided\n    if (switch_heuristic) {\n        solver-\u003eheuristic = inactive;\n    }\n\n    // Update selection count for the (potentially new) heuristic\n    solver-\u003emab_select[solver-\u003eheuristic]++;\n\n    // Reset standard MAB interval counters to prepare for next interval\n    // This ensures consistency with Kissat's internal bookkeeping\n    solver-\u003emab_decisions = 0;\n    solver-\u003emab_conflicts = 0;\n    solver-\u003emab_chosen_tot = 0;\n    \n    // Reset per-variable chosen counts\n    for (all_variables(idx)) {\n        solver-\u003emab_chosen[idx] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e","thoughtSignature":""}],"role":"model"},"finishReason":"STOP","index":0}],"modelVersion":"gemini-3-pro-preview"}}
